summary: Sourced explanation disposing of Candidate bb0a9eb98ae24e86beb491447e4aef7a, action=explained. Source reading answers its specific suspicion, so it is recorded as explained_by_existing_mechanism rather than escalated. Mechanism: the leaderLoop commitCh case reads commitment.getCommitIndex(), calls setCommitIndex and runs processLogs synchronously on the same main goroutine, so a consumed notification cannot skip or reorder entries (processLogs walks lastApplied+1..index, taking each entry from inflight futures or the LogStore, then sets lastApplied); if a higher-term RPC is selected before the notification is consumed, runLeader's deferred cleanup answers the still-inflight futures with ErrLeadershipLost while their entries stay in the durable log. The public Apply contract added as SourceRange S-api-apply-doc (api.go:804-813) states ErrLeadershipLost is indeterminate ('There is no way to guarantee whether the write succeeded or failed in this case'), so a future answered ErrLeadershipLost for an entry already counted committed is the documented outcome, not a mismatch; the node applies the committed index later via the new leader's LeaderCommitIndex (setCommitIndex + processLogs(idx,nil), protected by the monotonic lastApplied guard). Feedback cites the acquired Materials (ref_ids) to justify superseding the prior counterevidence/unknowns set. No map change is proposed; the recorded edges (B-quorum-commit/B-leader-apply over F-committed, with B-authority-loss support) still apply. Preflight returned valid:true; a controlled-schedule execution corroborating the composed protection remains unperformed and is retained as a residual unknown.
